result.summary: The pedestrian environment consists of a wide multi-lane roadway with a sidewalk and a marked crosswalk at a signalized intersection. Safety is limited by large bushes that obstruct sight lines at the corner and the significant exposure distance for pedestrians crossing the arterial.

hazards.name: Sight line obstruction
hazards.description: Large bushes at the corner block the view between pedestrians and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the intersection in the foreground

hazards.name: Wide crossing
hazards.description: Multiple lanes of traffic increase the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicles.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove or trim the overgrown vegetation at the corner to improve visibility.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Build out the sidewalk at the corner to reduce crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Install high-visibility pedestrian countdown signals.

result.summary: The image depicts a large, multi-lane signalized intersection serving a commercial area, characterized by a very wide crossing distance. While basic infrastructure like marked crosswalks and sidewalks are present, the environment is compromised by significant evidence of reckless driving and high exposure for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The intersection is extremely wide, increasing the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic without a refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway from the foreground to the mall entrance

hazards.name: Evidence of Reckless Driving
hazards.description: Large circular tire marks in the center of the intersection indicate frequent high-speed, out-of-control vehicle maneuvers.

hazards.name: Visibility Obstruction
hazards.description: Large vehicles, such as the cement truck, can block sight lines between pedestrians and other drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Install raised islands in the center of the roadway to provide a safe waiting area and reduce unprotected crossing distance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Automated Traffic Enforcement
interventions.description: Implement red-light and speed cameras to deter reckless driving behaviors like the 'donuts' visible in the intersection.

result.summary: The image shows a wide multi-lane intersection with marked continental crosswalks and pedestrian signals. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the long crossing distance and lack of a median refuge island increase pedestrian exposure to high-volume traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Design
hazards.description: Wide lanes and multiple through lanes encourage higher vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment consists of a wide sidewalk adjacent to a commercial strip mall, but it is compromised by a vehicle obstructing the walkway. There is a lack of defined pedestrian crossings or ADA-compliant ramps where the sidewalk meets the large asphalt parking lot and driveway area.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A brown SUV is parked directly across the pedestrian path, forcing people to walk into the active driveway area.

hazards.name: Unmarked Driveway Crossing
hazards.description: The transition from the sidewalk to the commercial parking lot lacks a marked crosswalk, creating conflict points between pedestrians and turning vehicles.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings across the driveway entrance to clearly delineate pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Bollards and Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install physical barriers such as bollards to prevent vehicles from parking on the sidewalk and obstructing the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and proper slopes at the sidewalk-to-driveway transition to ensure accessibility.
